concept.title: The Roots of Calglen
concept.logline: On rain-soaked, cozy Calglen, you race to recover the seed relics and restore the Moon Shrine.
concept.source_prompt: Swamp Fen. swamp marsh bog fen mission Courier run
concept.player_fantasy: You are a wanderer who arrives at Mossbrook Camp and becomes the one who brings the Moon Shrine back to life.

key_locations.name: Mossbrook Camp
key_locations.description: The start: a ring of tents around a fire pit.

key_locations.name: Woodcutter Camp
key_locations.description: Woodcutter Camp: a camp on the way out from Mossbrook Camp.

key_locations.name: Elder Grove
key_locations.description: Elder Grove: a grove on the way out from Mossbrook Camp.

key_locations.name: Overgrown Keep
key_locations.description: Overgrown Keep: a ruin on the way out from Mossbrook Camp.

key_locations.name: Great Stump
key_locations.description: Great Stump: a landmark on the way out from Mossbrook Camp.

key_locations.name: Moon Shrine
key_locations.description: Moon Shrine: the far end of the grand loop, where the story ends.

characters.name: Elder Isla
characters.description: Waits in Mossbrook Camp and knows why the Moon Shrine fell silent.

characters.name: Tobin the Scout
characters.description: Follows you from Mossbrook Camp and points out anything glinting nearby.

characters.name: Thorn Wolf
characters.description: A thorn wolf that prowls near its lair and runs down whatever it spots.

characters.name: Nadia the Trader
characters.description: Trades gossip about Calglen for anything shiny.

characters.name: Moss Hare
characters.description: A harmless moss hare that bolts if you come too close.

objectives_outline: Deliver each one to its recipient
Report back before time runs out
hazards: Thorn Wolf hunting near its lair

actions.value: On rain-soaked, cozy Calglen, you race to recover the seed relics and restore the Moon Shrine.
4 parcels, one clock. Pick each one up and get it where it belongs.
Delivered: the Woodcutter Camp Herb is with Nadia the Trader.
Delivered: the Elder Grove Herb is with Moss Hare.
Delivered: the Overgrown Keep Herb is with the Moon Shrine.
Delivered: the Great Stump Herb is with the Elder Grove.
Every parcel delivered, on the clock.
You are badly hurt. Back off and recover.

nodes.speaker: Elder Isla
nodes.text: So you've come to Mossbrook Camp at last. I am Elder Isla. On rain-soaked, cozy Calglen, you race to recover the seed relics and restore the Moon Shrine.

choices.text: What do you need from me?

nodes.speaker: Elder Isla
nodes.text: Back again. Mossbrook Camp is quieter while you're out there.

nodes.speaker: Elder Isla
nodes.text: Go to Woodcutter Camp, then Elder Grove. Whatever still remembers The Roots of Calglen is out there. Bring it back to me.

nodes.speaker: Elder Isla
nodes.text: Before anyone lived in Mossbrook Camp, The Roots of Calglen was kept by people who wrote nothing down. Eerie, even then.

nodes.speaker: Elder Isla
nodes.text: Woodcutter Camp: Woodcutter Camp: a camp on the way out from Mossbrook Camp.

nodes.speaker: Elder Isla
nodes.text: You found something out there. I can see it on you. That's one piece of The Roots of Calglen back where it belongs.

nodes.speaker: Elder Isla
nodes.text: Elder Grove: Elder Grove: a grove on the way out from Mossbrook Camp.

nodes.speaker: Tobin the Scout
nodes.text: Tobin the Scout circles your feet, then looks toward Overgrown Keep as if it already knows the way.

nodes.speaker: Tobin the Scout
nodes.text: Tobin the Scout sniffs the air. Something about Overgrown Keep has it restless.

nodes.speaker: Tobin the Scout
nodes.text: It turns toward Overgrown Keep. Overgrown Keep: a ruin on the way out from Mossbrook Camp.

nodes.speaker: Thorn Wolf
nodes.text: The thorn wolf watches you, low and still. It is not going to talk.

nodes.speaker: Nadia the Trader
nodes.text: Welcome to my corner of Mossbrook Camp. Nadia the Trader's wares have come a long way to get here.

nodes.speaker: Nadia the Trader
nodes.text: Rope, oil, dried fruit, and maps of The Roots of Calglen that are only a little wrong. Nothing you can't find for yourself, if you're patient.

nodes.speaker: Nadia the Trader
nodes.text: People say lights move at Woodcutter Camp after dark. I don't go there myself.

nodes.speaker: Moss Hare
nodes.text: The moss hare freezes, watches you with one bright eye, and looks ready to bolt.
